report.total_ulp_movement_note: Sum of |movement| over steps, measured in ULPs of each step's starting value. This is the per-step movement metric and does not blow up when a step crosses a binade boundary or zero.
report.total_representable_values_note: Sum of the exact count of representable float32 values between before and after each step. Correct, but at a sign crossing a single step contributes roughly 2.1 billion, so it is not a summary of how far the parameter travelled; see 'total_ulp_movement' for that.

stability.disclaimer: A small update, a small gradient, float32 storage stagnation, an oscillating update and a numerical plateau are five different observations. None of them establishes that the optimizer has converged, and none of them says anything about a global optimum: this instrument observes one coordinate of one parameter out of a high-dimensional optimization state.

note: Values are exactly as recorded. Floats are Python floats (IEEE-754 double) holding the exact value of the observed float32; hex and raw uint32 fields carry the stored binary32 word itself.
